title: repo-guard project configuration
description: Project-level protected-file, staged quality, notification, and Vue Lighthouse rules consumed by @cxyi7/repo-guard.

notification.description: Project-wide WeCom notification switch. Missing values stay enabled for compatibility.

enabled.description: Require WeCom delivery for notify-level rules. When false, protected changes are still recorded but no notification is sent.

lighthouse.description: Vue Lighthouse CI runner. The consuming project owns @lhci/cli, Chrome, routes, assertions, and lighthouserc configuration.

enabled.description: Run the Vue Lighthouse gate automatically from the managed pre-push hook. The explicit repo-guard lighthouse command can run while this is false.

configFile.description: Repository-relative Lighthouse CI config file. Null detects a standard lighthouserc filename.

buildScript.description: Project npm script run before Lighthouse collection. Null skips the build step.

timeoutMs.description: Timeout applied separately to the build, collect, and assert processes.

preCommit.description: Staged quality gates. Missing defaults can be materialized with repo-guard migrate.

stylelint.description: Stylelint gate loaded from the consuming project's installation and configuration.

enabled.description: Run the consuming project's Stylelint against staged style files before the protected-file gate.

pattern.description: Glob used to select staged files for Stylelint.

fix.description: Apply Stylelint auto-fixes before the final verification pass.

maxWarnings.description: Maximum Stylelint warning count allowed by the commit gate.

requireConfig.description: Require a project Stylelint configuration when the staged gate is enabled.

enabled.description: Run Prettier against staged files before the protected-file gate. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

pattern.description: Glob used to select staged files for Prettier.

fix.description: Format staged files automatically; false performs a check-only gate.

requireConfig.description: Require a project Prettier configuration for every matched file.

enabled.description: Run ESLint against staged files before the protected-file gate. New init configurations set this to true; omitted values stay false for upgrade compatibility.

pattern.description: lint-staged glob used to select staged files.

fix.description: Apply ESLint auto-fixes before the final verification pass.

maxWarnings.description: Maximum ESLint warning count allowed by the commit gate.

pattern.description: Repository-relative glob. * matches one path segment and ** crosses directories.

category.description: Human-readable category included in reports and notifications.

level.description: notify requires successful delivery when notification.enabled is true; audit only records the change.
